results.title: Vanished
results.overview: A defense contractor's world shatters when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. He launches into a desperate mission to save her and bring her home.

results.title: Pescador
results.overview: Parallel stories of two siblings. One follows a marine biologist searching for a mythical sea creature in Costa Rica, who perhaps has dark intentions. The other follows her shipwrecked older brother who is saved by a Costa Rican fisherman who believes he has found his new son.

results.title: He
results.overview: A woman desperate for affection and love has signed up for an unconventional dating service that utilizes a combination of dark magic and science to summon a shapeshifting entity to please any person it encounters.

results.title: Zombie Apache
results.overview: A greedy real estate developer desecrates a sacred Viking burial ground, unleashing a comical nightmare upon the unsuspecting locals.

results.title: Ashes from a Phoenix
results.overview: On the opening night of "Ashes from a Phoenix", an actress is chased from the memories of her past. Also a mythological creature visits her at the dressing room to help her.

results.title: The Newspaper
results.overview: In a pristine 1950s suburb, a newlywed discovers cryptic puzzles in the daily newspaper that hint at a buried town secret and her husband’s past. As the clues unravel, so does her reality.

results.title: The Beneath
results.overview: When an underground evil terrorizes her garden, a troubled woman must face her demons head-on to stop her fear.

results.title: wait lemme think
results.overview: up, down, wait. scritch, scratch, scream. smoke, yell, climb. wait, lemme think.

results.title: Fighting Giants
results.overview: A mother and daughter confront their relationship with grief during a surreal visit to Freetown, Sierra Leone.

results.title: Deep Fridge
results.overview: In "Deep Fridge" both Swarnava (Abir) and Mili (Tnusree) are victims of this vicious, prejudiced idea of a perfectly happy marriage. Will they be able to seek closure post their divorce and see things with more clarity in an effort to build a guilt free future for both of them separately which is fair to their only child Tatai.

results.title: The Great Reset
results.overview: An artificial intelligence, created from the mind of a rogue hacker, unleashes an apocalyptic plan to destroy the world and save the only person he ever loved: his daughter, Emma. Facing humanity's collapse and the haunting echoes of a broken past, Emma embarks on a race against time to save the world.

results.title: When a River Becomes the Sea
results.original_title: Quan un riu esdevé el mar
results.overview: The heroine, a young archaeology student, whose relationship with herself, and with those around her, is forever marked by a traumatic event. Initially, Gaia cannot find the words to describe her situation, let alone the courage to speak about it. Eventually, however – like an archaeological excavation – she begins to uncover fragments of the past in order to piece her life together.

results.title: Next
results.overview: What if dying were a little bit like going to the DMV? Well, Sara is about to find out.

results.title: The Diamond King
results.overview: Dick Perez, official Baseball Hall of Fame artist for over 20 years, painted the game's history and every inductee - a project he continues in his 80s. This childhood immigrant's portraits changed commemoration of America's iconic pastime.

results.original_title: Deus Me Livre, Mas Quem Me Dera

results.title: Fruitcake!
results.overview: A young woman losing her grip on reality returns home with a plan to face her past by building a boat.

results.title: Drug Bust Storm
results.overview: Border drug lords thrive as anti-narcotics police fight fiercely. Vice Captain Xiao Ruolan falls into a trap during a raid, missing, while an impostor infiltrates the force. Drug lord Chen Qiang plots a major deal. Conflicts erupt: real vs. fake Xiao, cartel infighting, and gunfights. Who survives when the truth emerges?
